chapter.514D10BB504C8924.chapter_subtitl: Start with power and metal infusion, then branch into ore chemistry, logistics, mining and QIO. Factories add parallel slots to operations you already understand.
Read top to bottom · hover a quest to see all its connections
Open a quest to inspect all prerequisites, including links to other chapters. Item tasks check inventory; the description explains assembly and a test run.

quest.5130110429A8D512.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 4 × Ultimate Logistical Transporter (mekanism:ultimate_logistical_transporter). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130110429A8D512.title: Obtain 4 × Ultimate Logistical Transporter
quest.513011076C9C7A8F.quest_desc: Armored Free Runners add armour to the Free Runners’ functionality. After upgrading, check charge, equip them as boots and confirm the intended mode is enabled.
Armour and energy-dependent movement features are separate properties. Running out of energy means the more expensive material does not guarantee the same fall protection; recharge first.
quest.513011076C9C7A8F.title: Obtain 1 × Armored Free Runners
quest.513011083EFED984.quest_desc: Free Runners are powered movement gear that can reduce fall damage. Charge them, equip them in the boots slot and test the active mode on a low step.
Protection depends on stored energy and mode. Completing the item quest does not grant permanent immunity to falls; check the pair you are actually wearing before descending from a height.
quest.513011083EFED984.title: Obtain 1 × Free Runners
quest.51301108B9C415A1.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Advanced Fluid Tank (mekanism:advanced_fluid_tank). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301108B9C415A1.title: Obtain 1 × Advanced Fluid Tank
quest.5130110E6A8F75F8.quest_desc: The Jetpack uses hydrogen rather than an electrical cable. Produce Hydrogen in the chemical line, fill the pack through a compatible item-filling slot and equip it in the chest slot.
Check fuel and flight mode close to the ground. An empty pack cannot keep your character airborne, so reserve hydrogen for the return trip and landing.
quest.5130110E6A8F75F8.title: Obtain 1 × Jetpack
quest.51301114CBAD1F77.quest_desc: The Quantum Entangloporter transfers supported resources over a shared frequency. Configure access, frequency and sides at both ends. This expands logistics; its recipe does not require a Digital Miner.
quest.51301114CBAD1F77.title: A quantum link between remote lines
quest.513011156F29CC4E.quest_desc: The Pressurized Reaction Chamber has three distinct inputs. Its starter recipe uses 2 Bio Fuel, 10 mB water and 100 mB hydrogen to produce 1 Substrate and 100 mB ethylene. Make Bio Fuel by crushing plant material in a Crusher; sawmill sawdust does not work here. Remove both the chemical and solid outputs or the machine will stop. Later PRC recipes lead to HDPE.
Guaranteed return of consumed components: 1 × Basic Chemical Tank.
Claim the refund after you or your team actually manufacture Pressurized Reaction Chamber. An item in storage or an already completed quest alone does not prove crafting.
quest.513011156F29CC4E.title: PRC: item + fluid + chemical
quest.5130111B9CDAD323.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Energy Tablet (mekanism:energy_tablet). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130111B9CDAD323.quest_subtitle: Osmium, FE and the first steel
quest.5130111B9CDAD323.title: Obtain 1 × Energy Tablet
quest.5130112203442BAE.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Hyper-Dense QIO Drive (mekanism:qio_drive_hyper_dense). The items are not consumed by this task.
Guaranteed return of consumed components: 1 × Base QIO Drive.
Claim the refund after you or your team actually manufacture Hyper-Dense QIO Drive. An item in storage or an already completed quest alone does not prove crafting.
quest.5130112203442BAE.quest_subtitle: QIO: storage for the final base
quest.5130112203442BAE.title: Obtain 1 × Hyper-Dense QIO Drive
quest.5130112244309BDE.quest_desc: The Osmium Compressor adds osmium to supported materials. This is a separate alloy line, including Refined Glowstone; its factory version scales the same operation.
quest.5130112244309BDE.title: Osmium for material compression
quest.51301124380E82AF.quest_desc: The Flamethrower uses Hydrogen as fuel. Fill it through a compatible chemical slot and check the mode before firing; an FE cable alone cannot refuel it.
Test it away from storage, conveyors and dropped items. Flame mode changes its interaction with targets, and nearby items can be lost; use a separate test area for workshop experiments.
quest.51301124380E82AF.title: Obtain 1 × Flamethrower
quest.5130113316FAEC33.quest_desc: One Elite Control Circuit needs 2 Advanced Control Circuits, 4 Reinforced Alloys, 1 Dimensional Matrix, 1 Quantum Processor and 1 diamond block. The recipe produces 1 circuit, so the two circuits consumed by the next tier require two complete batches.
Maintain separate production supplies of the previous circuits and alloys. JEI shows the exact current-tier recipe; check those supplies before ordering a large machine.
quest.5130113316FAEC33.title: Obtain 1 × Elite Control Circuit
quest.51301135FC827F35.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 4 × Elite Mechanical Pipe (mekanism:elite_mechanical_pipe). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301135FC827F35.title: Obtain 4 × Elite Mechanical Pipe
quest.5130113C675F054B.quest_desc: The Rotary Condensentrator converts a supported substance between fluid and chemical forms. Choose the correct mode and use the matching transport on each side. Liquid samples in the nuclear chapter are separate demonstrations of this operation.
quest.5130113C675F054B.title: Changing form in the Rotary
quest.513011447E582F7D.quest_desc: A Logistical Sorter extracts from the attached inventory and distributes items using filters and colors. Test one input with two destinations before adding more lines so unwanted items do not block machines.
quest.513011447E582F7D.title: Sorting before the split
quest.51301145216814C2.quest_desc: The Armored Jetpack combines a hydrogen jetpack with armour. Check its fuel after upgrading and equip it in the chest slot; armour materials do not replace Hydrogen.
Make a short control test near the base and check its mode in the tooltip. Armour does not make flight free or remove the need to watch fuel before crossing a drop.
quest.51301145216814C2.title: Obtain 1 × Armored Jetpack
quest.513011472102F0D8.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Basic Infusing Factory (mekanism:basic_infusing_factory). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011472102F0D8.quest_subtitle: Factories, a sawmill and the Cardboard Box
quest.513011472102F0D8.title: Obtain 1 × Basic Infusing Factory

quest.51301147649F4943.title: Obtain 1 × Basic Enriching Factory
quest.513011491E852F23.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Advanced Bin (mekanism:advanced_bin). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011491E852F23.title: Obtain 1 × Advanced Bin
quest.5130114EF06D538C.quest_desc: This native advancement checks a Robit being summoned in the world, beyond holding its item. Use its placement interaction to complete this optional workshop branch.
quest.5130114EF06D538C.title: Robit: summon the helper
quest.51301151F34C43A4.quest_desc: The Gas-Burning Generator consumes supported chemical fuel. Feed ethylene from the PRC through a buffer and compare generation with the whole production chain's demand. A blocked hydrogen supply or substrate output also interrupts fuel production.
Guaranteed return of consumed components: 1 × Steel Casing.
Claim the refund after you or your team actually manufacture Gas-Burning Generator. An item in storage or an already completed quest alone does not prove crafting.
quest.51301151F34C43A4.title: Ethylene returns as FE
quest.5130115863865D83.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Ultimate Fluid Tank (mekanism:ultimate_fluid_tank). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130115863865D83.title: Obtain 1 × Ultimate Fluid Tank
quest.51301167B744DDDA.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Solar Generator (mekanismgenerators:solar_generator). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301167B744DDDA.quest_subtitle: Factories, a sawmill and the Cardboard Box
quest.51301167B744DDDA.title: Obtain 1 × Solar Generator
quest.5130116A8EF3B812.quest_desc: The QIO Drive Array holds storage drives on a selected frequency. Install a drive, configure access and use a QIO Dashboard to work with the items. Its recipe does not require a Quantum Entangloporter, so storage has its own branch.
Guaranteed return of consumed components: 1 × Teleportation Core.
Claim the refund after you or your team actually manufacture QIO Drive Array. An item in storage or an already completed quest alone does not prove crafting.
quest.5130116A8EF3B812.quest_subtitle: QIO: storage for the final base
quest.5130116A8EF3B812.title: QIO: a frequency and its storage
quest.5130116E42F14F4E.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 4 × Advanced Logistical Transporter (mekanism:advanced_logistical_transporter). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130116E42F14F4E.title: Obtain 4 × Advanced Logistical Transporter
quest.513011740CB95726.quest_desc: The Formulaic Assemblicator executes a stored Crafting Formula. Supply the required ingredients, FE and a separate output route. Use it as a local station for a repeated crafting recipe.
quest.513011740CB95726.title: Local crafting from a formula
quest.51301174E90C0139.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 4 × Advanced Universal Cable (mekanism:advanced_universal_cable). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301174E90C0139.title: Obtain 4 × Advanced Universal Cable
quest.5130117ADB85508F.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Basic Crushing Factory (mekanism:basic_crushing_factory). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130117ADB85508F.title: Obtain 1 × Basic Crushing Factory
quest.51301180C64BE565.quest_desc: The Scuba Tank holds Oxygen for use with a Scuba Mask. Fill it from the oxygen chemical line; the hydrogen used by a Jetpack is not a substitute.
Equip both pieces, enable the tank and test breathing in shallow water. The tank without the mask is not a complete set; keep enough oxygen to return to the surface.
quest.51301180C64BE565.title: Obtain 1 × Scuba Tank
quest.513011835D892AF4.quest_desc: Install the base drive in the QIO Drive Array and check both item capacity and type capacity. The next three nodes expand the same storage rather than replacing its frequency and access setup.
Guaranteed return of consumed components: 1 × Ultimate Control Circuit.
Claim the refund after you or your team actually manufacture Base QIO Drive. An item in storage or an already completed quest alone does not prove crafting.
quest.513011835D892AF4.quest_subtitle: QIO: storage for the final base
quest.513011835D892AF4.title: QIO: the first drive

quest.51301190143553CA.title: Obtain 1 × Advanced Smelting Factory
quest.513011933F7B17EE.quest_desc: The Basic Fluid Tank stores water and other fluids. Place it between pump and consumer to see whether supply keeps up with demand; store chemicals in separate Chemical Tanks.
quest.513011933F7B17EE.title: A fluid buffer
quest.513011936DDEBB0E.quest_desc: One Advanced Control Circuit needs 2 Basic Control Circuits, 4 Infused Alloys, 1 Precision Mechanism, 1 Control Assembly and 1 redstone block. The recipe produces 1 circuit, so the two circuits consumed by the next tier require two complete batches.
Maintain separate production supplies of the previous circuits and alloys. JEI shows the exact current-tier recipe; check those supplies before ordering a large machine.
quest.513011936DDEBB0E.quest_subtitle: Factories, a sawmill and the Cardboard Box
quest.513011936DDEBB0E.title: Obtain 1 × Advanced Control Circuit

quest.5130119895187FB1.title: Obtain 1 × Supermassive QIO Drive
quest.513011A01B082BDB.quest_desc: The Scuba Mask is the head piece of the diving set. Underwater breathing requires it together with an oxygen-filled Scuba Tank; the mask alone does not provide an air reserve.
Wear the mask on your head, the tank in the chest slot, enable the tank and test in shallow water. Check the tank’s Oxygen before diving rather than the charge in an energy cube.
quest.513011A01B082BDB.title: Obtain 1 × Scuba Mask
quest.513011A22D5322FD.quest_desc: Infuse Enriched Iron with carbon again, then smelt the resulting Steel Dust into an ingot. This completes the initial steel line before the later factories.
quest.513011A22D5322FD.quest_subtitle: Osmium, FE and the first steel
quest.513011A22D5322FD.title: Second infusion → steel dust

quest.513011A31908F578.title: Obtain 1 × Combiner

quest.513011A34E3014FA.title: Obtain 1 × Electric Bow

quest.513011A804CB36C0.title: Obtain 4 × Advanced Mechanical Pipe
quest.513011AB8B3C455F.quest_desc: The Atomic Disassembler is an electric multipurpose tool. Charge it in a compatible energy slot and start in its normal mode; faster modes use more energy.

Check the current mode in the tooltip before working on your base. If enabled, Vein Mining targets connected eligible ore and logs rather than every possible structure; select single-block operation for precise work.
quest.513011AB8B3C455F.title: Obtain 1 × Atomic Disassembler
quest.513011ADC7A6AF6B.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Basic Compressing Factory (mekanism:basic_compressing_factory). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011ADC7A6AF6B.title: Obtain 1 × Basic Compressing Factory
quest.513011B3BB1DF1D9.quest_desc: The Precision Sawmill processes wood. A log gives planks and has a 25% chance of extra sawdust; a wooden stick always becomes one sawdust. Use sawdust for paper and the Cardboard Box. Substrate and ethylene in the PRC instead require Bio Fuel made by crushing plant material in a Crusher.
quest.513011B3BB1DF1D9.quest_subtitle: Factories, a sawmill and the Cardboard Box
quest.513011B3BB1DF1D9.title: Wood and sawdust
quest.513011C1277D6FAE.quest_desc: One portal uses a Teleporter at the bottom centre and nine Teleporter Frames around a vertical 1×2 opening, forming a 3×4 outline.

This kit builds one endpoint. Two fixed endpoints require a second frame, power and the same frequency; a Portable Teleporter can serve as the other endpoint. The native teleport-use check is retained.
The tasks check each material and quantity without consuming it. Hold the kit before placing it, then complete the separate formation or operation check where this quest has one.
Guaranteed return of consumed components: 1 × Steel Casing.
Claim the refund after you or your team actually manufacture Teleporter. An item in storage or an already completed quest alone does not prove crafting.
quest.513011C1277D6FAE.title: A working teleporter
quest.513011C1717043EB.quest_desc: The Chemical Oxidizer converts supported solid inputs into chemicals. Connect power, the item feed and a Pressurized Tube to the correct output. This machine also forms part of the later uranium line.
quest.513011C1717043EB.title: Solid feed → chemical output
quest.513011C1C75B6080.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Time-Dilating QIO Drive (mekanism:qio_drive_time_dilating). The items are not consumed by this task.
Guaranteed return of consumed components: 1 × Hyper-Dense QIO Drive.
Claim the refund after you or your team actually manufacture Time-Dilating QIO Drive. An item in storage or an already completed quest alone does not prove crafting.
quest.513011C1C75B6080.quest_subtitle: QIO: storage for the final base
quest.513011C1C75B6080.title: Obtain 1 × Time-Dilating QIO Drive
quest.513011C1D784F1C8.quest_desc: Feed iron and a carbon source into the Metallurgic Infuser to obtain Enriched Iron. This intermediate needs a second infusion before it becomes steel.
quest.513011C1D784F1C8.quest_subtitle: Osmium, FE and the first steel
quest.513011C1D784F1C8.title: First carbon infusion

quest.513011E2F7F7383A.title: Obtain 1 × Basic Injecting Factory
quest.513011E55E071B35.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Advanced Energy Cube (mekanism:advanced_energy_cube). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011E55E071B35.title: Obtain 1 × Advanced Energy Cube
quest.513011EFCFF5F40C.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Elite Fluid Tank (mekanism:elite_fluid_tank). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011EFCFF5F40C.title: Obtain 1 × Elite Fluid Tank
quest.513011F2453E9C69.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Refined Glowstone Ingot (mekanism:ingot_refined_glowstone). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011F2453E9C69.title: Obtain 1 × Refined Glowstone Ingot
quest.513011F824400CB9.quest_desc: One Ultimate Control Circuit needs 2 Elite Control Circuits, 4 Atomic Alloys, 1 Stellar Alloy, 1 Radiation Shield and 1 Quantum Processor. The recipe produces 1 circuit; an order of two circuits requires two complete batches.
Maintain separate production supplies of the previous circuits and alloys. JEI shows the exact current-tier recipe; check those supplies before ordering a large machine.
quest.513011F824400CB9.title: Obtain 1 × Ultimate Control Circuit
quest.513011FC2150E9F6.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 4 × Ultimate Universal Cable (mekanism:ultimate_universal_cable). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011FC2150E9F6.title: Obtain 4 × Ultimate Universal Cable
quest.513011FCD72A741B.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Basic Sawing Factory (mekanism:basic_sawing_factory). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011FCD72A741B.title: Obtain 1 × Basic Sawing Factory
quest.513011FD1111D1BA.quest_desc: A Basic Chemical Tank buffers hydrogen, oxygen and other chemicals. Use Pressurized Tubes and configure its inputs and outputs; an ordinary Fluid Tank stores a different form.
quest.513011FD1111D1BA.title: A tank for chemicals
quest.513011FD8F59F801.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Ultimate Bin (mekanism:ultimate_bin). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011FD8F59F801.title: Obtain 1 × Ultimate Bin
quest.514A110000000001.quest_desc: After the Precision Sawmill, turn its sawdust into a useful tool: four wood dust items in a 2×2 grid make one Cardboard Box. Sawing one wooden stick guarantees one sawdust; a log only has a chance to produce sawdust as a secondary output. Compatible Immersive Engineering wood dust also works in the box recipe.

Right-click a supported block with an empty box to pack its saved data and inventory. Break and collect the boxed block, place it at the destination, then sneak-right-click to restore the block and recover the empty box. For your first trial, move an ordinary chest containing a few items.

A box moves one permitted block, not a whole multiblock structure. SOQM prevents packing AE2 crafting CPU blocks to stop active autocrafting ingredients from being duplicated; finish or cancel their jobs and dismantle them normally. Other Mekanism restrictions still apply.

The objective checks one box in inventory without consuming it; moving the chest is a learning exercise, not an additional automatic condition. This optional branch does not block chemistry, reactors or the main route. Every member claims a personal engineering pack once for this quest.
quest.514A110000000001.quest_subtitle: Move a block without ordinary breaking
quest.514A110000000001.title: Mekanism: Cardboard Box
quest.514D110A613D8197.quest_desc: The Chemical Infuser prepares the reagent for the Chemical Injection Chamber. Supply hydrogen chloride for the ore line, then route the output through purification, crushing, enrichment and smelting. Keep the upstream fluid and chemical inputs separate.
Guaranteed return of consumed components: 1 × Advanced Chemical Tank.
Claim the refund after you or your team actually manufacture Chemical Infuser. An item in storage or an already completed quest alone does not prove crafting.
quest.514D110A613D8197.title: Hydrogen chloride for injection
quest.514D110FDA1C7CF6.quest_desc: Collect ingots from the steel line and Infused Alloy from the redstone line. Keep separate stocks: casings, cables and later circuits will consume both.
quest.514D110FDA1C7CF6.quest_subtitle: Osmium, FE and the first steel
quest.514D110FDA1C7CF6.title: Steel and alloy for casings
quest.514D1118901F8AB4.quest_desc: Feed material and oxygen into the Purification Chamber, then route its output through the Crusher, Enrichment Chamber and Energized Smelter. Keep every output clear and check JEI for the amounts produced from your chosen feed.
quest.514D1118901F8AB4.title: Oxygen adds a purification stage
quest.514D1121D23494BB.quest_desc: Connect a Wind Generator to the energy buffer and watch the FE balance while machines run. Size generation and cable throughput around the workshop's actual load.
Guaranteed return of consumed components: 1 × Energy Tablet.
Claim the refund after you or your team actually manufacture Wind Generator. An item in storage or an already completed quest alone does not prove crafting.
quest.514D1121D23494BB.quest_subtitle: Factories, a sawmill and the Cardboard Box
quest.514D1121D23494BB.title: Wind for continuous demand
quest.514D113A135370A8.quest_desc: Trace one batch from the Chemical Dissolution Chamber to finished ingots and inspect every by-product output and reagent supply. This objective retains its item check and manual confirmation; confirm it after your own test, since it does not automatically inspect the entire workshop.
quest.514D113A135370A8.title: Check the complete output route
quest.514D1147E2CB985B.quest_desc: Use the Configurator for connections and transport modes. In each machine's interface, assign input, output and energy sides and enable the required auto-ejection. Begin with a short route between two machines.
quest.514D1147E2CB985B.title: Configure machine sides
quest.514D114A28816D5D.quest_desc: A factory gives one operation parallel processing slots. Upgrade the bottleneck in your line; the following side quests show the specializations. This objective uses Mekanism's native advancement for obtaining a factory or applying a Tier Installer.
quest.514D114A28816D5D.quest_subtitle: Factories, a sawmill and the Cardboard Box
quest.514D114A28816D5D.title: A factory: parallel processing
quest.514D115314DFB698.quest_desc: The Chemical Washer uses water to clean slurry, and the Chemical Crystallizer turns it back into items. Feed those crystals through the Chemical Injection Chamber and the existing purification, crushing, enrichment and smelting line.
Guaranteed return of consumed components: 1 × Sealed Process Chamber.
Claim the refund after you or your team actually manufacture Chemical Crystallizer. An item in storage or an already completed quest alone does not prove crafting.
quest.514D115314DFB698.title: Slurry → crystals → the existing line
quest.514D1154FFE3DABB.quest_desc: Send a supported feed into the Enrichment Chamber and its output to the Energized Smelter. Check that feed's recipe in JEI: ore blocks, raw ore and other forms have different ratios, so the line does not promise one multiplier for every input.
quest.514D1154FFE3DABB.title: Ore → enrichment → smelting
quest.514D116574C816F4.quest_desc: The Enrichment Chamber turns redstone and carbon feedstocks into concentrated Infuser materials. Send them to the infusion input and compare their values in JEI before scaling circuit production.
quest.514D116574C816F4.title: Concentrated Infuser inputs
quest.514D1178A4D44AFB.quest_desc: Place a Basic Energy Cube between the FE source and consumers and configure its input and output. It adds stored energy rather than generation, so sustained operation still requires an adequate source.
quest.514D1178A4D44AFB.title: A buffer between generator and workshop
quest.514D117ECEE7DB61.quest_desc: The Chemical Dissolution Chamber starts the full chemical route. Feed the supported ore material and sulfuric acid shown in JEI; route dirty slurry to the Chemical Washer using chemical transport.
quest.514D117ECEE7DB61.title: Dissolution before washing
quest.514D118227E562E7.quest_desc: Osmium supplies the first machines and control components. Prepare a stock, then connect FE power to a Metallurgic Infuser. The central route leads to steel, casings and processing; side branches add capacity and equipment.
quest.514D118227E562E7.quest_subtitle: Osmium, FE and the first steel
quest.514D118227E562E7.title: Osmium: starting the machine line
quest.514D118CA784C98D.quest_desc: The Electric Pump feeds water to the Electrolytic Separator. Route hydrogen and oxygen into separate Pressurized Tubes or chemical tanks; an unwanted full output can stop separation. Oxygen supplies the next purification line.
quest.514D118CA784C98D.title: Water → hydrogen and oxygen
quest.514D118EBA5C411D.quest_desc: Logistical Transporters move items, Mechanical Pipes move fluids, and Pressurized Tubes move chemicals. These are separate systems: water and oxygen need different transport. Verify each flow between one pair of blocks first.
quest.514D118EBA5C411D.title: Three separate flows
quest.514D11AB5959BBF5.quest_desc: Configure the Digital Miner's area and filter, check its FE demand and reserve an output path. Crafting consumes the components listed in JEI; the side advancement for summoning a Robit is not an additional crafting requirement.
Guaranteed return of consumed components: 1 × Teleportation Core.
Claim the refund after you or your team actually manufacture Digital Miner. An item in storage or an already completed quest alone does not prove crafting.
quest.514D11AB5959BBF5.title: Digital Miner: filter and output
quest.514D11B512FA3533.quest_desc: Place a Heat Generator, connect a Basic Universal Cable to the machine's power input and check that its internal buffer charges. An Energy Cube in the next branch will bridge interruptions. The objective checks the listed items; assemble the working network in the world.
quest.514D11B512FA3533.quest_subtitle: Osmium, FE and the first steel
quest.514D11B512FA3533.title: FE: generator → cable → machine
quest.514D11B65A3EE8C0.quest_desc: The first Metallurgic Infuser costs 2 Iron Furnaces, 2 iron blocks, 2 redstone blocks, 1 osmium block, 1 Industrial Chassis and 1 Steel Casing. Prepare the Immersive Engineering steel workshop and enough iron for both furnaces. The first machine recipe uses none of its own alloys or circuits.
Feed copper and redstone for Infused Alloy: this version specifically uses copper. Iron with carbon starts a separate steel route through Enriched Iron; inspect both steps in JEI.

In Side Config, separate the ordinary item input, the Extra reagent input and the output. Separate machines are useful for different infusion types: material remains in the internal buffer and must be deliberately cleared when switching.
quest.514D11B65A3EE8C0.quest_subtitle: Osmium, FE and the first steel
quest.514D11B65A3EE8C0.title: Infuser: two material lines
quest.514D11EFB7B6F506.quest_desc: One Steel Casing needs 4 steel blocks, 1 osmium block, 2 Immersive Engineering steel plates, 1 glass and 1 Industrial Chassis. Make the first steel in Immersive Engineering’s Blast Furnace and the plates with a hammer or an already running Metal Press.

The casing does not require a Basic Control Circuit or Infused Alloy, so the first Metallurgic Infuser is accessible after the steel workshop. Once it runs, make the Basic Control Circuit from osmium and redstone using JEI.
Casings and circuits recur throughout the next machines. Separate ore processing, power and transport so each line can grow independently.
quest.514D11EFB7B6F506.quest_subtitle: Osmium, FE and the first steel
quest.514D11EFB7B6F506.title: Casings and basic control
quest.514D11F90042E7F4.quest_desc: Minimum evaporation plant: 4×3×4. The solid floor contains 16 blocks, the middle ring 12 and the top ring 8 with its four corners omitted. Leave the top centre open.
Of these 36 positions, one is the Controller, two are input/output Valves and the remaining 33 are Thermal Evaporation Blocks. Solar generators and an external heater are optional speed upgrades.
The kit builds one plant for water → brine. For continuous lithium production, add a second plant and feed it brine.
The tasks check each material and quantity without consuming it. Hold the kit before placing it, then complete the separate formation or operation check where this quest has one.
Guaranteed return of consumed components: 1 × Thermal Evaporation Block.
Claim the refund after you or your team actually manufacture Thermal Evaporation Controller. An item in storage or an already completed quest alone does not prove crafting.
quest.514D11F90042E7F4.title: Thermal Evaporation Plant: Complete Kit
